main.description: A Look: a named chain of effect steps with parameters, publishable to the author's repo and applicable to any image in Luminframe. Composition as data — a Look is rendered as its steps, so it can always be reopened and remixed. Steps reference builtin effect keys or com.luminframe.effect records; a Look may not reference another Look.

name.description: Display name shown in the effect library.

description.description: One-line blurb shown under the name.

steps.description: The ordered effect chain, applied first to last.

macros.description: The Look's exposed knobs, a JSON-encoded array of macro definitions (normalized 0..1 values bound onto step parameters). A string rather than an array of objects because the atproto data model has no float type — the same encoding as effectStep.params.

type.description: A builtin effect key or the AT-URI of a com.luminframe.effect record.

params.description: JSON-encoded parameter values for this step — same encoding as com.luminframe.image's effectStep.params.
